body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Dolby Laboratories displayed its LCD television set and the latest entertainment innovations at 2009 CES, which features Dolby Volume audio technology.

Also, Dolby is demonstrating 'Dolby Pro Logic IIz', its newest matrix decoding technology designed to add new dimension and spaciousness to home entertainment systems. Dolby Pro Logic IIz utilizes front height channels to create three-dimensional effects for a 7.1 or a 9.1 channel listening experience and is backwards-compatible with Dolby Pro Logic IIx technology.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
